answer: Require each identity to build an interaction graph: over many epochs it must exchange graded work with a diverse set of peers, so honest identities wander across the network like travelers crossing a tundra and accumulate varied connections. A Sybil farm's fakes mostly talk to each other, forming a dense clique with few bridges to the honest graph, and every link is sealed with a cipher keyed to that identity alone, so histories cannot be forged or shared. Discounting cliques forces an attacker to cultivate months of diverse real relationships per fake, a cost that cannot be bought in bulk.
